rows.text: For the fourth quarter of 2026, TTM estimates that net sales will be in the range of $1.42 billion to $1.44 billion, and non-GAAP net income will be in the range of $1.77 to $1.83 per diluted share.
These fourth quarter estimates result in full year 2026 expected net sales of $4.47 billion to $4.49 billion and expected non-GAAP net income in the range of $4.97 to $5.03 per diluted share.

In addition, we are initiating our preliminary 2027 full year forecast with expected net sales in the range of $6.5 billion to $6.75 billion and expected non-GAAP net income in the range of $8.10 to $8.90 per diluted share.
For the third quarter of 2026, TTM estimates that net sales will be in the range of $1.10 billion to $1.14 billion, and non-GAAP net income will be in the range of $1.21 to $1.27 per diluted share.
For full year 2026, TTM now expects net sales of approximately $4.4 billion and non-GAAP net income per share to approach $5.00.
